features.additionalInfo: You can make unlimited additional repayments (including the ability to pay the loan out early) without additional charge.
Unlimited fee free redraw when done online through CommBank App or NetBank.

You can switch your loan or repayment type, for example switching from a Digi Home Loan to a Standard Variable Rate or a Fixed Rate home loan or switch from Principal and Interest repayments to Interest Only payments.
Wherever you are in the world, CommBank gives you the choice and control to securely manage all of your accounts on a range of devices, the way you want.
Easily apply in minutes and download the CommBank app to proceed and manage your home loan online.

This loan can be used for the purposes of purchases, refinancing your existing home loan from other financial institution, personal needs (e.g. home renovations, consolidation of personal debt) and personal investments other than cryptocurrency or digital assets.
This loan cannot be used for business purposes, off the plan purchases, purchase of land, building and construction loans or bridging loans.

An Everyday Offset account is a transaction account that's linked to your Digi Home Loan or Investment home loan. Any money you put into your Everyday Offset account (e.g.  your salary and savings) - whether its $2 or $20,000 - reduces the balance on which we charge interest. This means you'll only be paying interest on the difference. You can have up to one Everyday Offset account linked to one Digi Home Loan. Only available for individual borrowers, not companies or trusts.

100,000 bonus CommBank Yello points when you digitally originate a new CommBank Home Loan. The earning and redemption of CommBank Yello points are subject to meeting the eligibility criteria, including holding an eligible transaction account, as well as the applicable CommBank Yello terms and conditions.

constraints.additionalInfo: Minimum $1,000 withdrawal with a $15 Redraw fee payable if you ask us via phone or in branch to support you with accessing your Additional Repayments. This fee is waived until 30 June 2025. There is no minimum withdrawal amount when accessing redraw electronically and no fee.
Minimum loan amount for new loans.
The total LVR for an existing and/or new Digi Home Loan cannot exceed 80% (subject to any postcode restrictions)

eligibility.additionalInfo: Available to Individuals only (Companies and/or Family/Unit/Hybrid Trusts are excluded).
Individuals must be 18 years of age or above
Customers must have a loan to value ratio of no more than 80% (i.e. at least a 20% deposit), unless postcode restrictions apply which may require a higher deposit amount.
Customers are comfortable to self-serve online, submit their Digi Home Loan application via online channels (e.g. NetBank and CommBank app), and use the CommBank app to complete the application.
CBA home loan customers cannot switch or internally re-finance into a digital home loan product.
Available only for customers purchasing or refinancing their loan from another financial institution to CommBank.

An individual living in Australia as: An Australian citizen, permanent resident or specified temporary Australian resident; New Zealand citizen; or overseas citizen co-borrowing with an Australian citizen or permanent resident. Or an individual living and working overseas as an Australian citizen or permanent resident.
Applications for home loans are subject to the Bank's normal credit approval.

fees.name: Establishment Fee
fees.additionalInfo: Payable to cover the costs the Bank incurs in establishing your loan and unless it is waived by us, is payable at the date of settlement or funding. It does not include other fees and charges also payable at the time of entering into the loan such as those associated with the settlement of the loan or the particular circumstances of the loan.

fees.name: Settlement Cheque Fee
fees.additionalInfo: $30 per cheque. Payable if you require additional cheques (more than two) to fund/settle the loan.

fees.name: Late Payment Fee
fees.additionalInfo: For home loans - If your account falls into arrears, you will be charged a late payment fee. This fee is payable on the fifth business day after the monthly repayment due date. We will continue to charge the fee monthly until you repay all arrears or you enter into an arrangement with us for the full repayment of those arrears (even if you repay your loan weekly or fortnightly). If you break that arrangement the fee will continue to apply.

fees.name: Paper Statement Fee
fees.additionalInfo: Payable if you opt out of electronic statements and request bi-annual paper statements, ask us to print a statement or provide you with an ad-hoc paper statement.

fees.name: Settlement Fee (Discharge)
fees.additionalInfo: Payable if you discharge the loan, i.e. either sell part or all of the Security Property or refinance your Loan with another credit provider.

fees.name: Security Substitution Fee
fees.additionalInfo: Payable if you ask us to substitute one of your securities with another.

fees.name: Stop Payment Notice Fee
fees.additionalInfo: Payable if you ask us to stop payment on a cheque you have written.

fees.name: Voucher Fee
fees.additionalInfo: $4 per voucher (minimum charge $12) or $60 per hour spent to retrieve voucher(s). Payable if you ask us to retrieve a voucher (i.e. deposit, credit or debit slips) that records a transaction on the Loan Account.

fees.name: Switching Fee
fees.additionalInfo: Payable when switching your loan purpose, repayment type or product type.

An Everyday Offset Account is a transaction account that's linked to your Simple Home Loan or Investment Home Loan. Any money you put into your Everyday Offset Account (e.g. your salary and savings) reduces the balance on which we charge interest. This means you'll only be paying interest on the difference. You can have up to two Everyday Offset Accounts linked to one Simple Home Loan. Only available for individual borrowers, not companies or trusts.

Your home loan comes with a fee-free redraw facility. You can make unlimited additional repayments at any time with no fees or penalties. You can access any additional money you pay, over and above your minimum required repayment.
You can apply to top up your home loan by an additional $10,000 or more - subject to equity in your property and our approval.
Ability to switch your loan or repayment type, for example switching from a Simple Variable Rate to a Fixed Rate home loan or switch from Principal and Interest repayments to Interest Only payments.
Wherever you are in the world, CommBank gives you the choice and control to securely manage all of your accounts on a range of devices, the way you want.

A guarantor is someone who agrees to be responsible for repaying a debt owed to us under a loan provided to another individual or business, if the borrower(s) can't make their repayments. A guarantor supports the loan by providing us with additional security such as a property they own. By providing a guarantee, we may lend to the borrower in situations where they may not have been able to secure the full amount on their own.

This loan can be used for the purposes of investment property purchases, refinancing your existing home loan,personal needs and personal investments other than cryptocurrency or digital assets and off the plan purchases.
This loan cannot be used for business purposes, purchasing of vacant land , bridging loan and building/construction purposes.
1-30 years (Subject to our approval)

Individuals must either be living in Australia as an Australian citizen, New Zealand citizen, Australian permanent resident or specified temporary Australian resident; or be an overseas citizen co-borrowing with an Australian citizen or Australian permanent resident or be living overseas as an Australian citizen or Australian permanent resident.

fees.name: Establishment Fee
fees.additionalInfo: $800 establishment fee charged for off the plan purchase for new and existing home loan. $300 establishment fee for home loans excluding off the plan purchases. Establishment fee is payable to cover the costs the Bank incurs in establishing your loan and unless it is waived by us, is payable at the date of settlement or funding. It does not include other fees and charges also payable at the time of entering into the loan such as those associated with the settlement of the loan or the particular circumstances of the loan. Establishment Fee is not charged for Simple Home Loan customers that are requesting top up or internally refinancing from another CommBank home loan type.

fees.name: Loan Service Fee
fees.additionalInfo: Charged monthly to each Loan Account on the repayment due date.

fees.name: Settlement Fee
fees.additionalInfo: Payable regardless of whether we attend settlement or not, when the Bank or our representatives, arranges the funding of the loan.

fees.name: Settlement Cheque Fee
fees.additionalInfo: Payable if you require additional cheques (more than two) to fund / settle the loan. Fee applied per cheque.

fees.name: Late Payment Fee
fees.additionalInfo: For home loans - If your account falls into arrears, you will be charged a late payment fee. The fee is payable on the fifth business day after the monthly repayment due date. We will continue to charge the fee monthly until you repay all arrears or you enter into an arrangement with us for the full repayment of those arrears (even if you repay your loan weekly or fortnightly). If you break that arrangement the fee will continue to apply.

fees.name: Settlement Fee (Discharge)
fees.additionalInfo: Payable if you discharge the loan, i.e. either sell part or all of the Security Property or refinance your Loan with another credit provider.

fees.name: Additional Security Fee
fees.additionalInfo: Payable if we require you to provide more than one security (i.e. the security used to support the repayment of the loan), and one or more of these securities is 'new' i.e. does not already secure another loan. Fee is applied  per 'new' security.

fees.name: Periodical Payments or Transfers
fees.additionalInfo: $1.80 plus transfer fee, bank cheque fee and postage as applicable. Payable if you arrange a periodical payment or ask us to transfer funds.

fees.name: Security Guarantee Fee
fees.additionalInfo: Payable if a guarantor is listed on the loan schedule. Fee is applied per borrower.

fees.name: Security Substitution Fee
fees.additionalInfo: Payable if you ask us to substitute one of your securities with another.

fees.name: Stop Payment Notice Fee
fees.additionalInfo: Payable if you ask us to stop payment on a cheque you have written. Fee is applied per request.

fees.name: Voucher Fee
fees.additionalInfo: $4 per voucher (minimum charge $12) or $60 per hour spent to retrieve voucher(s). Payable if you ask us to retrieve a voucher (i.e. deposit, credit or debit slips) that records a transaction on the Loan Account.

fees.name: Lenders' Mortgage Insurance/Low Deposit Premium
fees.additionalInfo: Lenders' Mortgage Insurance (LMI) or Low Deposit Premium (LDP) may apply where there is an increased risk associated with a home loan. The circumstances of your loan determine whether a loan will incur LMI or LDP. They are a one-off cost added to the total loan amount. The LMI premium is passed on to you and is not an establishment fee. The LDP is a bank fee and not an establishment fee.

fees.additionalInfo: Payable if you opt out of electronic statements and request bi-annual paper statements, ask us to print a statement or provide you with an ad-hoc paper statement.

fees.name: Settlement Fee (Discharge)
fees.additionalInfo: Payable if you discharge the loan, i.e. either sell part or all of the Security Property or refinance your Loan with another credit provider.

fees.name: Security Substitution fee
fees.additionalInfo: Payable if you ask us to substitute one of your securities with another.

fees.name: Stop payment notice fee
fees.additionalInfo: Payable if you ask us to stop payment on a cheque you have written.

fees.name: Voucher Fee
fees.additionalInfo: $4 per voucher (minimum charge $12) or $60 per hour spent to retrieve voucher(s). Payable if you ask us to retrieve a voucher (i.e. deposit, credit or debit slips) that records a transaction on the Loan Account.

fees.name: Switching Fee
fees.additionalInfo: Payable when switching your loan purpose, repayment type or product type.

rawProduct.name: Fixed Rate Home Loan
rawProduct.description: Choose a Fixed Options home loan with terms from 1 to 5 years and lock in certainty. Get a guaranteed interest rate and set repayments over your fixed term

features.additionalInfo: Peace of mind - Fixing your home loan, means you'll have greater certainty. You can lock in the same rate and repayments from 1-5 years.

features.additionalValue: Handy loan options - You can choose to lock in today's rate (fee applies), package and save for a $395 package fee or split your loan. Eligibility criteria, T&Cs apply.

features.additionalInfo: Prepay or redraw - Repay weekly, fortnightly or monthly. Plus, prepay or redraw up to $30,000 during your fixed term, with no break costs.
Split loan option
Keep your loan - Selling and buying a new home? Take your loan and rate with you and pay no break costs. Conditions apply.
The product includes a combination loan feature.
The product provides options which includes repayment holiday, portability, progressive drawdown, parental guarantee and lenders mortgage insurance.
The product provides switching (from another product) feature
Loan Payment Method - Direct Debit (preferred), Direct Credit, Branch Payment, Internet or Phone Banking
Repayment types: Principal and Interest, Interest Only, or Interest Only in Advance
Repayment frequencies includes weekly, fortnightly or monthly.
Subject to terms and conditions, this product includes extra repayment features.
The product includes fraud protection features.
Subject to terms and conditions, this product includes guarantor features.
Relationship management is available for eligible customers.
Cancellation of the package: You may cancel your Package at any time by giving us a written request. Your Package will be cancelled, and all benefits will cease, when we receive your written request.
Statements of account: We will send you a statement of your loan account at least every six months or more frequently if you request

Comparison rate: The comparison rate is based on a loan of $150,000 over the term of 25 years. WARNING: This comparison rate is true only for the examples given and may not include all fees and charges. Different terms, fees or other loan amounts might result in a different comparison rate.

Break costs on fixed loan prepayments and switching: customers can make total prepayments of up to $30,000 (cumulative) for fixed loans, without costs or fees applying. You may incur a break cost and administration fee if your prepayments exceed this threshold, or if at any time before the end of a fixed rate period you switch to another product, interest rate (fixed or variable) or repayment type.

Rate Lock: We'll apply the fixed rate available on the loan settlement date or the date your fixed rate term starts, unless you lock a fixed rate on your loan using our Rate Lock feature. The fixed rate lock-in fee is 0.10% of your loan amount. At the end of the fixed rate term, the interest rate will roll onto our standard variable home loan interest rate, unless a new fixed rate term's selected and then the fixed rate is determined two business days before the end of the fixed term.
Home and Landlord Insurance: Premier Advantage Package customers may be eligible for an ongoing premium discount of up to 10% on their Westpac Home and Landlord Insurance policies. T&Cs applies

fees.name: Lenders Mortgage Insurance Premium
fees.additionalInfo: If your deposit is less than 20% then Lenders Mortgage Insurance is usually required. There may be other circumstances where Lenders Mortgage Insurance is also required. As Lenders Mortgage Insurance reduces bank's risk as a lender when providing a home loan, you may be able to apply for a home loan and get into your home sooner, with a lower deposit. Lenders Mortgage Insurance insures bank for any shortfall in the event that you default on your loan and if the proceeds from the property sale are not enough to pay off the loan in full. The cost of Lenders Mortgage Insurance is calculated as a percentage of the loan amount. The percentage applied will vary depending on a number of factors. Please speak to your lender if you would like to understand this process in more detail. The cost of Lenders Mortgage Insurance premium is passed on to you. We do not receive a commission on Lenders Mortgage Insurance.

features.additionalInfo: If you’re at least one full repayment ahead, you can redraw $500 or more with no fees. It’s simple to redraw using NAB Internet Banking.
Control from your pocket. Stay on top of your home loan through the NAB App. You can track your home loan progress, estimate your property equity and more.
Flexible repayments. Choose when you make your repayments - weekly, fortnightly or monthly.

eligibility.additionalValue: Australian citizen or permanent resident, or New Zealand citizen. Restrictions apply if residential address is an overseas addresss.

eligibility.additionalInfo: Lending criteria apply.

discounts.additionalInfo: The Offer is available for new lending only (including refinances and limit increases for existing borrowers). The Offer is not available for any variation or change of loan purpose of any existing NAB home loan where a new application is not required.

eligibility.additionalInfo: The Offer is available from 1 November 2019 until withdrawn by NAB. NAB may vary or end this offer at any time without notice. To be eligible for the Offer, an application must be submitted during the period that the offer is available and then approved, and drawn down within the time period set out in the applicant’s loan offer.

rawProduct.name: NAB Tailored Home Loan
rawProduct.description: Home loans for every need with tools, calculators and guides to help you choose.

features.additionalInfo: Save on interest with a 100% interest offset arrangement for variable rate home loans. 10 Offset accounts.
Stay on top of your home loan through the NAB App. You can track your home loan progress, estimate your property equity and more.
If you’re at least one full repayment ahead, you can redraw $500 or more with no fees. It’s simple to redraw using NAB Internet Banking. And the redraw is not available for fixed rate loans
Can be used as a construction loan. The loan can be used to let you make progressive payments to your builder. It includes interest-only repayment options with terms of one or two years.
Customer can have a variable interest rate, a fixed interest rate, or have a mix of fixed and variable rates.
Customer can make additional repayments unlimited on variable rate loans, and up to a total of $20,000 on fixed rate loans.

eligibility.additionalValue: Australian citizen or permanent resident, or New Zealand citizen. Restrictions apply if residential address is an overseas addresss.

eligibility.additionalInfo: Lending criteria apply.

features.additionalInfo: Access using ANZ Internet Banking or ANZ App
ANZ Redraw could let you access extra payments you've made to an eligible loan when you need to. You can easily access your redraw funds via ANZ Internet Banking and other convenient ways.

An offset account is a transaction account linked to an eligible home or investment loan. The money you have in this account could offset the amount you owe on that loan, and you'll only be charged the interest on the difference.

If you're buying your first home, you could get $3,000 to spend however you like, plus support from an ANZ First Home Coach. Available to eligible first home buyers with an ANZ home loan of $250,000 or more.

Drawdown within 180 days of applying, bonus paid after settlement. Eligibility criteria and T&Cs apply.

features.additionalInfo: Access using ANZ Internet Banking or ANZ App
ANZ Redraw could let you access extra payments you've made to an eligible loan when you need to. You can easily access your redraw funds via ANZ Internet Banking and other convenient ways.

If you're buying your first home, you could get $3,000 to spend however you like, plus support from an ANZ First Home Coach. Available to eligible first home buyers with an ANZ home loan of $250,000 or more.

Drawdown within 180 days of applying, bonus paid after settlement. Eligibility criteria and T&Cs apply.

fees.additionalInfo: Expenses payable in the event of default.  You will be required to pay expenses reasonably incurred by ANZ  in enforcing or preserving its rights under your agreement or any security interest provided to ANZ  in connection with your agreement. These expenses include those incurred by ANZ in preserving or maintaining property secured, collection expenses and expenses resulting from dishonour of a cheque or payment. Enforcement expenses may be debited in the same way as other fees and charges.
fees.name: Enforcement expenses

fees.additionalInfo: Lenders Mortgage Insurance protects your lender in the event that you default on your home loan and there is a 'shortfall'. A shortfall happens when the proceeds from the sale of your home are not enough to cover the outstanding amount you owe to your lender. If your loan with ANZ requires LMI, ANZ will arrange it and will tell you the cost of the premium and any additional information that may be required. You may also be charged stamp duty, depending on the State or Territory where the security property for your loan is located.

rawProduct.description: Our fixed rate home loan gives you the certainty of knowing what your repayments will be during the fixed period. ANZ Fixed Home Loans are available for periods between of at least 1 year and up to 30 years in duration.
rawProduct.name: ANZ Fixed Rate home loan

eligibility.additionalInfo: You must be 18 years of age or older to apply

eligibility.additionalValue: Australian citizens, New Zealand citizens or Australian permanent residents

eligibility.additionalInfo: Applicant's primary income is in Australian Dollars

features.additionalInfo: With an ANZ One offset account, you could offset the amount you owe on your one-year fixed rate home loan and you'll only be charged interest on the difference.
Access using ANZ Internet Banking or ANZ App

Not available during fixed rate period. Once your loan reverts to the Standard Variable Rate, the redraw option may be available to allow you access to additional repayments you may have made to your loan.

If you're buying your first home, you could get $3,000 to spend however you like, plus support from an ANZ First Home Coach. Available to eligible first home buyers with an ANZ home loan of $250,000 or more.

Drawdown within 180 days of applying, bonus paid after settlement. Eligibility criteria and T&Cs apply.

You can make extra repayments up to a set available tolerance amount (the lesser of 5% of the loan amount at the start of the fixed rate period or $5,000) in each year of the fixed rate period. If the total fixed rate period is less than a year, the tolerance amount is reduced proportionally. If you choose to make additional repayments above this tolerance amount, repay your fixed rate loan (in part or in full), with our consent, or switch to a new fixed interest rate or variable interest rate before the end of your fixed rate period, change the term of the current fixed interest rate period of your loan or change certain terms of your loan, you may have to pay an early repayment cost.

fees.additionalInfo: We will not charge a Loan Approval Fee/Facility Approval Fee in respect to the establishment of your new loan/facility. Please refer to ANZ Personal Banking General Fees and Charges booklet for further information.
fees.name: Loan Approval Fee

fees.additionalInfo: We will not charge a Valuation Administration Fee for any valuations we undertake on properties relating to the establishment of your loan/facility. Refer to the ANZ Personal Banking General Fees and Charges booklet for further information.
fees.name: Valuation Administration Fee

fees.additionalInfo: We will not charge a Guarantee Administration Fee where a guarantee is taken by us for the purpose of securing your loan/facility. Refer to ANZ Personal Banking General Fees and Charges booklet for further information.
fees.name: Guarantee Administration Fee

fees.additionalInfo: We will not charge a monthly Loan Administration Charge for your loan. Refer to ANZ Personal Banking General Fees and Charges booklet for further information.
fees.name: Loan Administration Charge

fees.additionalInfo: We will not charge a Renegotiation Fee or a further Loan Approval Fee/Facility Approval Fee if we approve an application by you to renegotiate or convert your loan/facility. Refer to ANZ Personal Banking General Fees and Charges booklet for further information.
fees.name: Renegotiation Fee (Non Credit Critical)

fees.additionalInfo: Charged when a payment remains unpaid for 30 days or more after it is due. A further fee is payable monthly when the loan continues to be in arrears. Refer to ANZ Personal Banking General Fees and Charges booklet for further information.
fees.name: Late Payment Fee

fees.additionalInfo: This fee is payable if you'd like to lock in the interest rate at the time of your application for up to 90 days. The Lock Rate fee will be $750 for every $1M of lending. Refer to ANZ Personal Banking General Fees and Charges booklet for further information.
fees.name: Lock Rate Fee

fees.additionalInfo: Payable for each document that ANZ lodges or registers with any person or authority in respect of your loan or any security provided for your loan, where ANZ is required or entitled to lodge or register that document. This fee is not charged on establishment of your loan. Refer to ANZ Personal Banking General Fees and Charges booklet for further information.
fees.name: Lodgement Fee

fees.additionalInfo: Payable for each Certificate or Title or other security document ANZ produces at your request, in connection with your loan. This fee is not charged on establishment of your loan. Refer to ANZ Personal Banking General Fees and Charges booklet for further information.
fees.name: Production Fee

fees.additionalInfo: Payable each time that ANZ is required to attend a settlement (or attend to an electronic settlement) in relation to any advance made under your Loan, or in relation to any securities provided or varied in respect of your Loan. The fee is payable on the date of the settlement and is not dependent on the settlement being successful. This fee is not charged on establishment of your loan. Refer to ANZ Personal Banking General Fees and Charges booklet for further information.
fees.name: Settlement Fee

fees.additionalInfo: Payable each time that ANZ obtains information from governmental or regulatory records in connection with the loan/facility or any security. This fee is not charged on establishment of your loan. Refer to ANZ Personal Banking General Fees and Charges booklet for further information.
fees.name: Search Fee

fees.additionalInfo: We will not charge a Renegotiation Fee or a further Loan Approval Fee/Facility Approval Fee if we approve an application by you to renegotiate or convert your loan/facility. Refer to ANZ Personal Banking General Fees and Charges booklet for further information.
fees.name: Renegotiation Fee (Full Credit Critical)

fees.additionalInfo: You may have to pay this if you pay your loan off in full, make an early or extra repayment, or make certain other changes to your loan, during any fixed-rate period.  This is calculated specifically related to the individual event. More details and method of calculation are given in the ANZ Consumer Lending Terms and Conditions booklet under the heading 'Repaying your loan early or making other changes to your loan during a fixed interest rate period'. This booklet can be found on anz.com.
fees.name: Early Repayment Cost

fees.additionalInfo: Lenders Mortgage Insurance protects your lender in the event that you default on your home loan and there is a 'shortfall'. A shortfall happens when the proceeds from the sale of your home are not enough to cover the outstanding amount you owe to your lender. If your loan with ANZ requires LMI, ANZ will arrange it and will tell you the cost of the premium and any additional information that may be required. You may also be charged stamp duty, depending on the State or Territory where the security property for your loan is located.
fees.name: Lenders Mortgage Insurance

fees.additionalInfo: Generally, stamp duty and other fees are normally payable at settlement when purchasing a new property. The amount is determined by the state or territory revenue office.
fees.name: Stamp Duty - Mortgage Document

fees.additionalInfo: Generally, stamp duty and other fees are normally payable at settlement when purchasing a new property. The amount is determined by the state or territory revenue office.
fees.name: Stamp Duty - Transfer Land

fees.additionalInfo: Expenses payable in the event of default.  You will be required to pay expenses reasonably incurred by ANZ  in enforcing or preserving its rights under your agreement or any security interest provided to ANZ  in connection with your agreement. These expenses include those incurred by ANZ in preserving or maintaining property secured, collection expenses and expenses resulting from dishonour of a cheque or payment. Enforcement expenses may be debited in the same way as other fees and charges.
fees.name: Enforcement expenses

fees.additionalInfo: If we deal with, vary or supplement our security documentation to comply with your requirements, we may charge a fee. An estimate of the fee can be provided once your specific requirements have been ascertained. Please refer to ANZ Personal Banking General Fees and Charges booklet for further information.
fees.name: Other Services

fees.additionalInfo: Payable to the government body when registering a mortgage over a property. Refer to the relevant state/territory revenue office for the amount.
fees.name: Registration of Mortgage

fees.additionalInfo: Payable to the government body when discharging an existing mortgage over a property. Refer to the relevant state/territory revenue office for the amount.
fees.name: Discharge of Mortgage

fees.additionalInfo: We will not charge a Loan Approval Fee/Facility Approval Fee in respect to the establishment of your new loan/facility. Please refer to ANZ Personal Banking General Fees and Charges booklet for further information.
fees.name: Loan Approval Fee

fees.additionalInfo: We will not charge a Valuation Administration Fee for any valuations we undertake on properties relating to the establishment of your loan/facility. Refer to the ANZ Personal Banking General Fees and Charges booklet for further information.
fees.name: Valuation Administration Fee

fees.additionalInfo: We will not charge a Guarantee Administration Fee where a guarantee is taken by us for the purpose of securing your loan/facility. Refer to ANZ Personal Banking General Fees and Charges booklet for further information.
fees.name: Guarantee Administration Fee

fees.additionalInfo: We will not charge a monthly Loan Administration Charge for your loan. Refer to ANZ Personal Banking General Fees and Charges booklet for further information.
fees.name: Loan Administration Charge

fees.additionalInfo: We will not charge a Renegotiation Fee or a further Loan Approval Fee/Facility Approval Fee if we approve an application by you to renegotiate or convert your loan/facility. Refer to ANZ Personal Banking General Fees and Charges booklet for further information.
fees.name: Renegotiation Fee (Non Credit Critical)

fees.additionalInfo: Charged when a payment remains unpaid for 30 days or more after it is due. A further fee is payable monthly when the loan continues to be in arrears. Refer to ANZ Personal Banking General Fees and Charges booklet for further information.
fees.name: Late Payment Fee

fees.additionalInfo: This fee is payable if you'd like to lock in the interest rate at the time of your application for up to 90 days. The Lock Rate fee will be $750 for every $1M of lending. Refer to ANZ Personal Banking General Fees and Charges booklet for further information.
fees.name: Lock Rate Fee

fees.additionalInfo: Payable for each document that ANZ lodges or registers with any person or authority in respect of your loan or any security provided for your loan, where ANZ is required or entitled to lodge or register that document. This fee is not charged on establishment of your loan. Refer to ANZ Personal Banking General Fees and Charges booklet for further information.
fees.name: Lodgement Fee

fees.additionalInfo: Payable for each Certificate or Title or other security document ANZ produces at your request, in connection with your loan. This fee is not charged on establishment of your loan. Refer to ANZ Personal Banking General Fees and Charges booklet for further information.
fees.name: Production Fee

fees.additionalInfo: Payable each time that ANZ is required to attend a settlement (or attend to an electronic settlement) in relation to any advance made under your Loan, or in relation to any securities provided or varied in respect of your Loan. The fee is payable on the date of the settlement and is not dependent on the settlement being successful. This fee is not charged on establishment of your loan. Refer to ANZ Personal Banking General Fees and Charges booklet for further information.
fees.name: Settlement Fee

fees.additionalInfo: Payable each time that ANZ obtains information from governmental or regulatory records in connection with the loan/facility or any security. This fee is not charged on establishment of your loan. Refer to ANZ Personal Banking General Fees and Charges booklet for further information.
fees.name: Search Fee

fees.additionalInfo: We will not charge a Renegotiation Fee or a further Loan Approval Fee/Facility Approval Fee if we approve an application by you to renegotiate or convert your loan/facility. Refer to ANZ Personal Banking General Fees and Charges booklet for further information.
fees.name: Renegotiation Fee (Full Credit Critical)

fees.additionalInfo: You may have to pay this if you pay your loan off in full, make an early or extra repayment, or make certain other changes to your loan, during any fixed-rate period.  This is calculated specifically related to the individual event. More details and method of calculation are given in the ANZ Consumer Lending Terms and Conditions booklet under the heading 'Repaying your loan early or making other changes to your loan during a fixed interest rate period'. This booklet can be found on anz.com.
fees.name: Early Repayment Cost

fees.additionalInfo: Lenders Mortgage Insurance protects your lender in the event that you default on your home loan and there is a 'shortfall'. A shortfall happens when the proceeds from the sale of your home are not enough to cover the outstanding amount you owe to your lender. If your loan with ANZ requires LMI, ANZ will arrange it and will tell you the cost of the premium and any additional information that may be required. You may also be charged stamp duty, depending on the State or Territory where the security property for your loan is located.
fees.name: Lenders Mortgage Insurance

fees.additionalInfo: Generally, stamp duty and other fees are normally payable at settlement when purchasing a new property. The amount is determined by the state or territory revenue office.
fees.name: Stamp Duty - Mortgage Document

fees.additionalInfo: Generally, stamp duty and other fees are normally payable at settlement when purchasing a new property. The amount is determined by the state or territory revenue office.
fees.name: Stamp Duty - Transfer Land

fees.additionalInfo: Expenses payable in the event of default.  You will be required to pay expenses reasonably incurred by ANZ  in enforcing or preserving its rights under your agreement or any security interest provided to ANZ  in connection with your agreement. These expenses include those incurred by ANZ in preserving or maintaining property secured, collection expenses and expenses resulting from dishonour of a cheque or payment. Enforcement expenses may be debited in the same way as other fees and charges.
fees.name: Enforcement expenses

fees.additionalInfo: If we deal with, vary or supplement our security documentation to comply with your requirements, we may charge a fee. An estimate of the fee can be provided once your specific requirements have been ascertained. Please refer to ANZ Personal Banking General Fees and Charges booklet for further information.
fees.name: Other Services

fees.additionalInfo: Payable to the government body when registering a mortgage over a property. Refer to the relevant state/territory revenue office for the amount.

fees.additionalInfo: Payable to the government body when discharging an existing mortgage over a property. Refer to the relevant state/territory revenue office for the amount.

rawProduct.name: Macquarie Offset Home Loan
rawProduct.description: The Macquarie offset home loan package is designed to reduce your interest repayments, bucket your savings and access your savings without additional fees.

bundles.name: Offset Home Loan Package
bundles.description: Our offset home loan package gives you the option to add a credit card with a waived annual fee for the credit card for the life of your home loan. Lending criteria and T&Cs apply.
bundles.additionalInfo: Add a credit card. Waived annual fee for credit card for the life of your loan. Terms and Conditions apply.

eligibility.additionalInfo: Minimum age requirement.
Lending criteria, fees and T&Cs apply.

features.additionalInfo: Open up to 10 offset transaction accounts per loan account with an optional Debit Mastercard. Offset home loans must have at least 1 offset transaction account linked to a variable loan account with a minimum loan size of $20,000. Offset transaction accounts can only be linked to variable rate loans.

Have up to 6 loan accounts on settlement and unlimited after settlement. Each loan account can be set up with either principal and interest or interest only repayments for up to 5 years (subject to credit approval). Each loan account can also be set up with either a variable rate or a fixed rate for periods of 1-5 years. Repayments are due monthly.

Access to online banking and mobile banking app. Pay Anyone available with a $100,000 daily limit across all eligible accounts linked to a Macquarie ID for customers who use the Macquarie Authenticator App and a daily limit of $2,000 for customers without Authenticator. BPAY® out available up to the available balance of your account.
Construction Loans. Borrowers can draw down their home loan in stages to fund their renovation or new home build.
Repayments can be made via Direct Debit or Salary Credit/Electronic Funds Transfer.
Access additional payments you've made through the redraw facility. Redraw cannot be accessed on fixed rate loan accounts until after the fixed period expires.
Maximum Loan term of up to 30 years.
Minimum increase amount $25,000.

Extra repayments can be made in addition to regular monthly loan repayments. Note: You can make extra repayments on your fixed home loan of up to $10,000 per account which can be made each year without penalty (additional payments above this amount may incur break costs). The 12-month period is calculated from the date the fixed term commenced.
Subject to review, a guarantor can be nominated during the loan origination process.

fees.name: Construction Administration Fee
fees.additionalInfo: A one-off fee payable at settlement which covers valuation costs and progress payments during construction period.

fees.name: Annual Package Fee
fees.additionalInfo: $124 charged every 6 months in arrears based on loan Settlement Date. One package fee covers up to 5 loan applications that are submitted within 6 months, and where borrowers are common across each of the applications

fees.name: Break Cost
fees.additionalInfo: Break costs may be payable on early repayment during fixed rate periods if any of the following three events occur: 1. The whole of a fixed rate Loan Account is repaid. 2. The borrower makes additional repayments in excess of $10,000 into a fixed rate Loan Account in any year of the fixed rate term (i.e. in any 12 months from the date the fixed rate period commences). 3. The borrower changes the whole or part of the fixed rate Loan Account to another type of interest rate or repayment type, including changing to a different fixed rate period. The break cost could be substantial. Contact us for further information.

fees.name: Documentation Fee
fees.additionalInfo: Payable to the Lender in relation to preparing your loan documents and arranging settlement.

fees.name: Low Deposit Fee
fees.additionalInfo: Applicable for loans with an LVR >80%, where a once off amount is payable by the borrower, in connection with the low deposit being paid, and/or the low amount of equity the borrower has in the security property.

fees.name: Special Attendance Fee
fees.additionalInfo: Payable if the borrower requests a special service (for example consenting to a dealing with the Mortgage Property), in addition to any third party fees.

fees.name: Third Party Fees
fees.additionalInfo: Payable if the Lender incurs a fee from any third party, including our solicitors, as a result of any matter relating to the Loan Agreement or Security after the Settlement Date. This fee includes GST.

fees.name: Mortgage Discharge Fee
fees.additionalInfo: Payable if you request a full discharge of any Mortgage, in addition to any third party fees.

fees.name: Third party Settlement Fee
fees.additionalInfo: Payable when the Lender incurs a fee from any third party, including our solicitors, as a result of any matter relating to the settlement of your loan.

fees.name: Break Cost Fee and Prepayment Fee
fees.additionalInfo:
A Break Cost Fee is payable to us each time any of the following break events occur during a fixed rate period:
•	at your request, we agree to vary your annual percentage rate; or
•	you repay your loan account balance in full.
A Prepayment Fee is payable to us if, during a fixed rate period, you prepay an amount (repay more than your required repayments) that exceeds 20% of:
•	if the fixed rate period started on the date we first advanced any part of the amount of credit, the amount of credit – in which case the prepayment amount is the amount you prepay during the fixed rate period less 20% of the amount of credit; or
•	if the fixed rate period started on a date after the date we first advanced any part of the amount of credit, the loan account balance at the start of the fixed rate period – in which case the prepayment amount is the amount you prepay less 20% of the loan account balance at the start of the fixed rate period.

fees.name: Break Cost Fee
fees.additionalInfo:
Payable each time any of the following Break Events occur during a Fixed Rate Period: 
• at your request, we agree to change the Annual Percentage Rate under your Contract; 
• you repay your Loan Account balance in full; or 
• you make an additional repayment (by repaying more than your required repayments 
under your Contract) where the total of all additional repayments you have made 
since the start of the Fixed Rate Period or, if later, the anniversary of that date, that 
exceeds $20,000.00.
